purpose: Forecast unseen malicious network transitions from benign-trained dynamics rather than attack-family classification.
training_rule: World-model parameters are fit only on histories whose complete 8-minute history and complete next-4-minute target are benign. No attack-family label is an input or training target.

temporal_protocol.evaluation_positive: clean 8-minute history ending 30-240 seconds before a target attack onset
temporal_protocol.evaluation_negative: clean history followed by a complete benign 4-minute future

feature_policy.environment_normalization: Each cutoff uses only its own preceding 8-minute history median and IQR to form a causal coordinate system.

world_model.training: benign-only one-step transitions in normalized state coordinates
world_model.risk: maximum robust distance of predicted future states from the benign future-state envelope
world_model.risk_calibration: empirical percentile on calibration benign rollouts

claim_boundary: A passing result supports unseen-behaviour future warning under these three held-out campaigns. It does not imply detection of every zero-day attack.
